post.headline: Over 70% of Nigerian tenants pay rent without paper.
lines: This week's reports show many still pay cash without a proper receipt.
But memory no be paper, and paper dey save stress.
A dated rent receipt is your proof of payment, your shield.
Don't just pay; make sure you get a receipt in return.
post.cta: Send this to a friend who always pays cash for their rent.

threads.text: Over 70% of Nigerian tenants pay rent without proper receipts. When you pay rent, your only proof is that paper. No receipt, no proof. What is the one thing your receipt must have?
threads.evening: A proper rent receipt protects you from paying twice. It must be dated and show the amount paid. Insist on it every time you pay.

why: This post is an engagement question for Ngozi, using a STAT hook about rent payment habits, aligning with the payday window and the need to improve Facebook comments and Threads replies, while promoting the rent receipt tool.
